required_topics: sex trafficking prevention and response training

signage_details.posting_location: back of house poster in all staff visible locations
required_content: Minnesota Lodging Sex Trafficking Prevention and Response Training

risks_or_constraints: Non-compliance can lead to legal repercussions.
notes: Employees under 16, those working exclusively in a restaurant providing catering services, or with no direct contact with guests are exempt.
MDH encourages tribal nations and seasonal employees to use the materials but does not explicitly exempt them from training requirements.
Training is mandatory for whole house vacation rental properties licensed as hotels/motels.
